fact: The health ministry's quarterly bulletin N°01-SNIS-2026 for the fourth quarter of 2025 publishes health statistics compiled from data collected at health facilities and passed up the health information circuit, and is one of a numbered quarterly series.
title: Bulletin trimestriel N°01 - SNIS-2026 (Quatrième trimestre 2025)
publisher: Ministère de la Santé et de l'Hygiène Publique, Bureau de Stratégie et de Développement
